segments.title: Part 1 (0-5s): 晨光大廳與開場提問 / Sunlit Lobby Entrance & Hook
segments.prompt: [Scene] Charming vintage European-style bank atrium in Studio Ghibli cel-animation style, warm morning sunlight streaming through tall arched windows, potted ferns and brass teller lamps glowing gently. [Camera] Slow cinematic dolly-in starting from wide medium-shot, pushing closer to the young consultant. Timeline: 0-2.5s: Friendly young Taiwanese consultant in navy blue suit steps into the golden light, carrying a brown leather ledger notebook under arm. 2.5-5.0s: Turns warmly toward camera with an intelligent smile, gesturing invitingly. [Look] Studio Ghibli watercolor cel-animation aesthetic, soft hand-painted gouache background, gentle floating dust particles in warm golden hour light. Audio: Faint distant brass clock ticking, rustling ledger paper, peaceful morning ambience, <d>[Chinese] 大家都很好奇：銀行為什麼要推經濟利潤專案？</d>.

segments.title: Part 2 (5-10s): 走向講台與天秤揭示 / Walking to Desk & Balance Scale Reveal
segments.prompt: Create a 5-second live-action cinematic film continuing seamlessly from the exact last frame, pose, camera angle, and lighting of the previous segment. [Scene] Same warm sunlit vintage bank hall, rich dark oak furniture. [Camera] Smooth rightward tracking pan rotating slightly around the consultant as he steps toward a carved wooden desk. Timeline: 0-2.5s: Consultant walks smoothly to the desk, placing his ledger down and resting one hand near an antique brass balance scale. 2.5-5.0s: Points gently toward the balance scale, eyes alight with enthusiasm. [Look] Studio Ghibli animation look, rich polished wood grain reflections, warm brass metallic sheen. Audio: Crisp footsteps on parquet wooden floor, soft cloth movement, <d>[Chinese] 核心目標，就是為了建立更合理的績效衡量機制！</d>.

segments.title: Part 3 (10-15s): 傳統利潤與四大成本 / Accounting vs Economic Profit Pillars
segments.prompt: Create a 5-second live-action cinematic film continuing seamlessly from the exact last frame, pose, camera angle, and warm lighting of the previous segment.
